name: Exact Projection Full Opacity
definition: A volume rendering technique that identifies a primary front object and optionally a significant background object, blending them based on density and distance thresholds rather than performing full front-to-back accumulation.
summary: Exact Projection Full Opacity is a non-photorealistic volume rendering technique that identifies a primary front object and optionally one background object, blending them directly based on density and distance thresholds instead of performing full front-to-back accumulation.
